description: Which builds of a project an automatic clean up would move to the 7 day restore list right now, the storage it would free, and which old builds it keeps on purpose (newest build of each platform, a channel's current build, builds in a client delivery, builds sent to TestFlight or Google Play in the last 90 days, builds marked keep). Uses the project's saved rule, or keep (newest N per platform, 5 to 200) and olderDays (30, 60, 90 or 180) if given; with both, a build goes only when it breaks both. Read only: nothing is deleted. The rule is set on the project's Testing page; a person runs a clean up with the CLI (appforshare cleanup). Pro and Team.

keep.description: Keep the newest N builds per platform

olderDays.description: Remove builds older than this many days

name: cleanup_preview
title: Preview a clean up of old builds
